ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (AIRSPACEPARCEL) (AIRSPACE PARCEL) (this “Agreement"or “ZLDA") made as of the 9th day of May, 2023 by and betweenHARIOHM REALTY LLC("Owner"),a NewYork limited liability company having an address at 23 Hayloft Lane, Roslyn Heights, New York 11577, and HARIOHM AIR PARCEL LLC ("Developer"), a New York limited liability company having an address at 23 Hayloft Lane, Roslyn Heights, New York 11577. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with a building and improvements thereon,that isbelowahorizontalplane drawn at anelevationof110feet above DatumLevel (as hereinafter defined) (the“Lower LimitingPlane"),and is located in theBorough and County of Queens,City and State of NewYork,designated as Lot 19 in Block 9991 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map"), and as and by the street address 138-68 94th Avenue, Queens, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the“Owner Land"; the building located thereon and any replacements thereof is herein referred to as the“Owner Building";and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner in fee of the parcel of air which lies above the Lower Limiting Plane and contains no buildings or improvements, and is coterminous with the more particularly described on Exhibit “B” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Airspace Parcel"); WHEREAS,the Owner Building contains less“floor area,”as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) than is available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to theAirspaceParcel; WHEREAS,by execution ofa Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date andcontemporaneouslyherewith(the“Declaration"),Owner and Developer agree that theOwner Parcel and the Airspace Parcel comprise a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot"), which Combined Zoning Lot may only be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement, which Combined Zoning Lot is more particularly described on Exhibit “C-1" annexed hereto and made a part hereof, and which Combined Zoning Lot is more particularly depicted on the Air Lot Survey on Exhibit “C-2” annexed hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer confirm herein that the Subject Floor Area Development Rights now or hereafter allocable or attributed to the Combined ZoningLot shall be owned by Developer and shall be allocated to theAirspaceParcel; WHEREAS, all "parties in interest”(as defined in the definition of “zoning lot” in the Zoning Resolution)to the Combined Zoning Lot as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification 2
